sloka: हीना हिमवतः पार्श्वए किन्नरेणेन किन्नरा ।न हि राममहम् दृष्ट्व प्रवसन्तम् महावने ॥२-१२-७४॥
transliteration: hīnā himavataḥ pārśvae kinnareṇena kinnarā ।na hi rāmamaham dṛṣṭva pravasantam mahāvane ॥2-12-74॥

translations.english: With Rama living in the wilderness and Sita crying, I do not hope to survive for long, indeed.
